annotation.title_clean: The Government of Spain regulates artificial intelligence to ensure its reliable, ethical and guaranteed use
annotation.title_en: The Government of Spain regulates artificial intelligence to ensure its reliable, ethical and guaranteed use
annotation.authors_or_issuer: La Moncloa - Government of Spain (Council of Ministers)
annotation.summary_en: Government press page on the 26 May 2026 Council of Ministers meeting, which approved a draft Organic Law for the proper use and governance of AI, adapting the EU AI Act nationally and sending it to Parliament. It covers sandbox governance, public-sector AI delegates and supervisory competences. It also covers unrelated items such as a DTT licence and flexible retirement.
key_provisions_or_claims: Council of Ministers approved draft Organic Law on proper use and governance of AI, sent to Parliament
Law develops the EU AI Act in the national framework
Establishes governance of regulatory sandboxes and compliance facilitation for AI providers
Promotes an 'AI delegate' figure and higher transparency demands in the public sector
Minister rejects dichotomy between regulation and competitiveness
